fields.label: TANeSW Login (used by every TANeSW user)
TANeSW ID
fields.description: One TANeSW login for the whole team. Every ERPNext user with the TANeSW User or TANeSW Operations role works through it: no personal TANeSW credentials needed. Background jobs use it too when no watcher account is set. A personal TANeSW User Account, if one exists, still takes precedence for that user. Only System Managers can change these fields; the password is never shown.

fields.label: Warehouse Code (Our ICD)
fields.description: Our ICD's TANeSW code, e.g. WITZDL019. Used for logins, our cargo, carry-ins and inspections.

fields.label: Background Watcher Account
fields.description: Optional: leave empty to use the TANeSW Login above.

fields.label: Fallback Watcher Account
fields.description: Optional: leave empty to use the TANeSW Login above.

fields.label: Ready-to-Declare Watch Initialized
fields.description: Set by the first run after deployment, which records every vessel's landed count without alerting.

fields.label: Email Allocation Alerts
fields.description: Also email new / changed vessel allocations and newly landed containers to the operations team only: enabled users with the role TANeSW Operations. Bell notifications still go to every TANeSW user. Nobody with the role means no email.

fields.label: Track Vessels Arrived In The Last (days)
fields.description: Hourly: containers on our B/Ls of these vessels are read from TANeSW Cargo Tracking (reports: TANeSW Container Allocation / TANeSW Container Dwell). Containers not yet received at the ICD keep being tracked after that.

fields.label: Link Carry-Ins to icd_tz
fields.description: Every 5 minutes: read our TANeSW carry-in and handover reports and fill the matching Best Pick Movement Order (same manifest MRN, truck, container and B/L) while the truck is on the road. The Container Reception is made and submitted from our Carry-In screen. See TANeSW Carry In Container for each container's result.

fields.label: Also Draft Receptions for Portal Carry-Ins
fields.description: Off (recommended): receptions are made and submitted from our Carry-In screen, where the gate gives the yard location and clerk. A carry-in made in the TANeSW portal still gets its Movement Order filled, then waits as 'Awaiting Reception' until someone opens it on our Carry-In screen and presses 'Receive into ERP'. On: a portal carry-in also gets a DRAFT Container Reception for the clerk to finish and submit by hand.

fields.label: Allow Best Pick Orders Without Manifest
fields.description: Ops can create a Best Pick Movement Order before the driver goes to the port with only the transporter, driver, truck and trailer. When TANeSW's handover says which box that truck took, the manifest, container and B/L are filled in. Changes field settings on Container Movement Order (manifest not required on Best Pick; manifest and ship details fillable after submit, once only); icd_tz's code is not changed. Untick to put the settings back.

fields.label: Track Allocation Changes Box by Box
fields.description: Records every box that leaves or joins our allocation, with where it went (report: TANeSW Diverted Containers; 'Diverted' card on the Manifest). A vessel's manifest Excel is downloaded from TANeSW only when something points at a change: its B/L or box count moved (allocation watcher), the container sync saw a new box or a box leave our B/Ls, its ERP Manifest was just uploaded, or it has none yet and Create ERP Manifest is on. Otherwise once a day as a safety net. On its own nothing in the ERP Manifest changes unless the options below are ticked.

fields.label: Create ERP Manifest for New Allocations
fields.description: A vessel allocated to us with no ERP Manifest gets one, made from TANeSW's Excel by icd_tz's own import.

fields.label: Terminal Codes to Manifest Ports
fields.description: One per line: TANeSW terminal code = the Port name used on ERP Manifests, e.g. WTTZDL008 = TEAGTL. A manifest whose terminal is not listed is created as Draft for the Port to be set.

fields.label: Create Manifests As
fields.description: Draft: Ops check and submit. Submitted: submitted at once when the port is known from TANeSW (WTTZDL007 = DP WORLD, WTTZDL008 = TEAGTL); otherwise left as Draft with a comment.

fields.label: Apply TANeSW Changes to ERP Manifests
fields.description: Boxes added in TANeSW are added to the ERP Manifest (with their B/Ls, consignees and ICD Container / ICD Master BL records). Boxes removed in TANeSW come off it, unless a Movement Order, Container or Reception already exists: those stay and are flagged. Ticking this makes the Manifest's four tables editable after submit (Property Setters); unticking puts that back. icd_tz's code is not changed.

fields.label: Check Port Charges Against TANeSW
fields.description: Port charges (Purchase Order / Purchase Invoice lines per ICD Container) are raised from the ERP Manifest on the day it is uploaded, so a box TANeSW later moves to another ICD stays charged to us. With this on: saving such a document warns about lines for boxes already recorded as gone; submitting first re-reads the vessel from TANeSW (unless checked in the last 30 minutes) and then stops or warns, see below.

fields.label: When a Line Is for a Box That Is Not Ours
Track TANeSW Anomalies
fields.description: After each hourly container sync, compare TANeSW with the ERP and write the Container Allocation Track log (delivered on TANeSW not in ERP / unbilled / unpaid, diverted, ghost arrival / pending submit, stranded at port past the ICD Setting free days). Replaces the GitHub delivery tracker and allocation daemon: switch those workflows off the same day.

fields.label: Reception Dates (Container Reception vs TANeSW Carry-In)
Check Reception Dates Against TANeSW
fields.description: Every hour, compare each submitted Container Reception of the last 45 days with the TANeSW carry-in at our ICD and record Matches / Posted Late / Posted Early / Time Differs / No TANeSW Carry-In, with the storage days a late Posting Date costs (report: TANeSW Reception Date Check). Read-only: submitted receptions are flagged, never changed.

fields.label: On Reception Save
fields.description: Applies only while 'Check Reception Dates Against TANeSW' is ticked, when a clerk saves or submits a Container Reception whose Posting Date differs from the TANeSW carry-in. Warn (default): only tell the clerk. Correct: set Posting Date and ICD Time In to the TANeSW carry-in, which moves the storage start date and so the customer's storage charge; choose it only by an explicit decision. Off: nothing.
Fail-closed master switch. Enabling this does not bypass per-operation contract validation.
fields.label: Enable TANeSW Write Operations
Test Mode (nothing sent to TANeSW)
fields.description: For a test site only. Buttons work, but no write reaches TANeSW: Carry-In Submit is simulated and only creates the ERP records (movement order, Container Reception); every other write is refused. An orange TEST MODE badge shows on every TANeSW screen. Never tick on the live server: carry-ins would not reach TRA.
Never stores passwords, bearer tokens, or authorization headers.
